2607.09452.title: Practical Source Code Recovery from Binary Functions Using Anchor-Based Retrieval and LLM Reasoning
2607.09452.paper_summary: We present a practical pipeline for recovering source code from stripped binary functions by combining reverse engineering, anchor-based source code retrieval, and large language model reasoning. Our binary-to-source-code retrieval method attempts to identify the source function from a source code database, rather than generating approximate decompiled pseudocode. It extracts anchors such as strings, constants, external calls, and available function names using Ghidra, retrieves candidate files via an inverted-index search database, narrows candidates to likely function snippets, and re-ranks them with a large language model (LLM) based on disassembly, decompiled code, and source metadata. Confident matches can also serve as anchors in later passes. In an evaluation backed by our high-fidelity source code database on a stripped, optimized tcpdump binary, our proposed binary-to-source matching method achieves 95.2% assembly instruction coverage. Experiments on a GitHub-based retrieval database showed lower performance with 35.5% instruction coverage on average, mainly due to retrieval misses. These results show that source-level binary recovery excels with high-quality databases and remains a useful tool in noisy environments.
2607.09452.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個實用的管道，通過結合逆向工程、基於錨點的源代碼檢索和大型語言模型推理，從剝離的二進制函數中恢復源代碼。我們的二進制到源代碼檢索方法旨在從源代碼數據庫中識別源函數，而不是生成近似的反編譯偽代碼。它使用 Ghidra 提取字符串、常量、外部調用和可用函數名稱等錨點，通過反向索引搜索數據庫檢索候選文件，將候選項縮小到可能的函數片段，並根據反組譯、反編譯代碼和源元數據使用大型語言模型 (LLM) 重新排序它們。可靠的匹配也可以在後續過程中作為錨點。在我們基於高保真源代碼數據庫的評估中，針對剝離的優化 tcpdump 二進制文件，我們提出的二進制到源匹配方法實現了 95.2% 的組合指令覆蓋率。在基於 GitHub 的檢索數據庫上的實驗顯示，平均指令覆蓋率為 35.5%，主要是由於檢索失敗。這些結果表明，源級二進制恢復在高質量數據庫中表現出色，並在噪聲環境中仍然是一個有用的工具。
